scenes.name: SIFT TWICE
lines: Sift flour once, and the sieve catches the lumps.
面粉筛一遍，筛子拦下面疙瘩。
Sift it again, and the sieve catches nothing at all.
再筛一遍，筛子什么也拦不住了。
That dull second pass is the key. In symbols, P squared equals P.
这无聊的第二遍是关键。写成符号：P² = P。

scenes.name: TWO DRAWERS
lines: Start with the smallest projector: a two by two matrix with a single one on the diagonal, top left.
从最小的投影算子开始：一个 2×2 矩阵，只在左上（对角线上）有一个 1。
Square it: the one stays one, the zeros stay zero. P squared is P.
自己乘自己：1 还是 1，0 还是 0，所以 P² = P。
Its partner puts its one at the other end of the diagonal. They multiply to zero and add up to the identity: two drawers, nothing left out.
搭档把 1 放在对角线另一头。两者相乘为零、相加为单位矩阵：两只抽屉，不遗漏。

scenes.name: WIPE THE CORNERS
lines: Take a qubit whose Bloch arrow points zero point six across, zero point eight up.
取一个量子比特，布洛赫箭头横向 0.6、竖向 0.8。
Its density matrix: zero point nine and zero point one on the diagonal, zero point three in each corner.
它的密度矩阵：对角线上是 0.9 和 0.1，两个角上各是 0.3。
The diagonal is what Z reads. The corners are the coherence between the drawers.
对角线是沿 Z 读到的东西；两个角是两只抽屉之间的相干。
Measure along Z without looking. The corners are wiped to zero, and the diagonal stays.
沿 Z 测一次但不看：两个角被抹成零，对角线不动。
Do it again. No corners are left to wipe, so nothing moves.
再做一次：没有角可抹了，什么也不动。

scenes.name: UNREAD TWICE
lines: Lean checks this for any finite record measurement, on matrices of any size: unread twice is unread once.
Lean 内核检验：任意有限记录投影、任意大小方阵，未读两次即未读一次。
Why? Different drawers multiply to zero, and each drawer squared is itself.
为什么？不同的抽屉相乘为零，每只抽屉的平方是它自己。
Why trust that something is there? Not because it came first, but because asking twice gives the same answer.
我们凭什么相信某样东西在那里？不是因为它先在那里，而是因为问两遍，答案一样。
A thing is whatever the same ruler can measure twice without a change.
所谓实体，就是同一把尺子连量两次而不走样的东西。

scenes.name: LINE AND PLANE
lines: So how much did the corners carry? Keep a ledger.
那么，抹掉的角值多少？记一本账。
The state is pure: purity one, minus one half, leaves a surplus of one half.
这是纯态：纯度 1，减去 ½，盈余是 ½。
Each Z reading sits zero point four from even. Square both and add: zero point three two, the line's share.
Z 的两个读数各离均匀值 0.4；平方相加得 0.32，这是线上的一份。
The other zero point one eight lives in the plane at right angles: twice the corner squared.
剩下的 0.18 住在与线垂直的平面里：角上数值平方的两倍。
Booked this way, Lean checks the general split: the surplus is the visible deviations plus what is left in the perpendicular space.
按这样记账，Lean 内核检验一般的分解：盈余等于可见偏离加上正交补里的剩余质量。
So the pinch wipes the plane and keeps the line. After one pass: zero point three two and zero. After two: the same.
捏合抹掉面上那份、留下线上那份。一遍后：0.32 和 0；两遍后：一样。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: Not looking is not collapse. Reading a result keeps one drawer and rescales it.
不看不等于坍缩。读出结果，是留下一只抽屉再重新归一。
Pinching again never returns the lost zero point one eight. Where it went is chapter four.
再捏多少次，丢掉的 0.18 也回不来；它去了哪儿，见第四章。
And existence as a line you check twice is this book's reading, not a theorem.
至于“存在就是能连查两次的线”，这是本书的诠释，不是定理。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter three.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第三章
